storage: Fridge at the coldest point, covered, and cook within 1–2 days; freeze in a sealed bag for longer. Thaw overnight in the fridge.
looksLike: A long silver-grey sea fish, sold cut across into round steaks about 1–2 cm thick, with pale pink-white flesh, a thin grey-silver skin edge and one small central bone.
howToPick: Firm, springy flesh that does not leave a dent; shiny skin; clean sea smell. Avoid dull, grey or brown flesh, flaking, a sour or ammonia smell, or steaks sitting in milky liquid.
shelfLife: Fresh: 1–2 days in the fridge; frozen: about 3 months for best quality (general guidance, not from a source in this run).
substitutes: Pomfret steaks or small whole pomfret

usedIn.raw: 150 g raw steaks, skin and bone on (about 2 medium steaks; about 135 g edible) per serving
